task_criteria: The install command accepts --name as an alias for the positional NAME on BOTH documented entry points: hermes-h3 install --name X --endpoint URL registers the harness X and exits 0; the positional form hermes-h3 install X --endpoint URL keeps its exact previous behaviour; passing neither name form exits non-zero with a message naming the missing name; when both forms are given the positional NAME wins (the verify convention); the plugin front-end hermes h3 install --name X --endpoint URL reaches the same click command with the same resolved name; tests in tests/test_cli.py and tests/test_h3_plugin.py cover the alias, the missing-name failure and the conflict; the full shim pytest suite exits 0; ruff check and ruff format --check are clean on the changed files.

tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ The install command accepts --name as an alias for the positional NAME on BOTH documented entry points: hermes-h3 install --name X --endpoint URL registers the harness X and exits 0; the positional form hermes-h3 install X --endpoint URL keeps its exact previous behaviour; passing neither name form exits non-zero with a message naming the missing name; when both forms are given the positional NAME wins (the verify convention); the plugin front-end hermes h3 install --name X --endpoint URL reaches the same click command with the same resolved name; tests in tests/test_cli.py and tests/test_h3_plugin.py cover the alias, the missing-name failure and the conflict; the full shim pytest suite exits 0; ruff check and ruff format --check are clean on the changed files.: Click CLI (src/h3_shim/cli.py:686-696, 713-733): `@click.argument("name", required=False)` + `--name`/`name_opt`, `resolved = name if name is not None else name_opt`, `raise click.UsageError("install requires a harness name: ...")` when None. Live CliRunner evidence: `install --name X --endpoint http://u:1` -> exit 0, "installed harness 'X' at http://u:1 (rest)", config harnesses={'X':...}; positional `install X --endpoint ...` -> exit 0 identical output/config (diff vs HEAD~1 shows the positional path writes the same dict, same echo, same default_harness promotion); neither form -> exit 2 with "Error: install requires a harness name: pass it positionally (install NAME ...) or with --name NAME"; both `install pos --name flag` -> exit 0, "installed harness 'pos'", 'flag' absent from harnesses (positional wins). Plugin mirror (h3/__init__.py:166-179, 286-296): positional `nargs="?"` + `--name` dest=name_opt, `_argv_from_namespace` falls back to `<field>_opt` and omits unset values. Live evidence: `_setup` parser on ['install','--name','X','--endpoint','http://u:1'] rebuilds argv ['install','X','--endpoint','http://u:1'] -> same click command exit 0, same config; unset name rebuilds ['install','--endpoint',...] -> click exit 2 with the same missing-name message. Tests: tests/test_cli.py test_install_name_flag_alias / test_install_without_name_fails_loudly / test_install_positional_wins_over_name_flag; tests/test_h3_plugin.py test_install_name_flag_parses / test_install_name_flag_rebuilds_positional_argv / test_install_flag_and_positional_behave_identically. Command evidence: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` -> "375 passed, 4 warnings in 23.25s", EXIT=0; `ruff check src/h3_shim/cli.py h3/__init__.py tests/test_cli.py tests/test_h3_plugin.py` -> "All checks passed!", CHECK_EXIT=0; `ruff format --check` same files -> "4 files already formatted", FMT_EXIT=0; read_lsp_diagnostics -> 0 findings.
All DF-H3-3 requirements verified: --name alias works on both the click CLI and the hermes h3 plugin mirror with positional-wins and loud missing-name failure, tests cover all three cases, and the full suite (375 passed, exit 0) plus ruff check/format are clean.
